name: PaliGemma 3B pt-224
license_note: Gemma license. Gated on the Hub.
notes: Init checkpoint for π₀, π₀-FAST, and π₀.₅. OpenPI's PaliGemmaWeightLoader reads gs://vertex-model-garden-paligemma-us/paligemma/pt_224.npz; this repo is the official PyTorch conversion of that file (SigLIP-So400m/14 at 224 + Gemma 2B). The mix checkpoint is a later multitask finetune, and PaliGemma 2 is a Gemma 2 model.
convention: question used verbatim (it carries its options and answer instruction), greedy; lettered items scored by VLMEvalKit can_infer exact matching, open items by normalized exact match
